title: Accepted Knowledge Topic Catalog
body_html:
Accepted Knowledge Topic Catalog

This catalog records the immediate accepted-node topic folders. The frontmatter is a compatibility header for mdblueprint versions before exact topics.md files are reserved.

Topics

  • strategic_games - accepted strategic-game seed definitions and examples.
  • zero_sum - accepted zero-sum seed definitions and theorem targets.

Boundary

Accepted nodes preserve stable ids. New extraction work should usually go under docs/knowledge/staged/ before admission.
